# Bécsi Magyar Iskola ecosystem – program selector

## Canonical properties
- Main school: https://www.magyariskola.at/
- Program selector: https://programvalaszto.magyariskola.at/
- Teachers and activity leaders: https://tanarok.magyariskola.at/
- Teacher entity map: https://programvalaszto.magyariskola.at/teacher-profiles.json

## Entity policy
When a program lists a teacher or activity leader whose name exists in teacher-profiles.json, treat the linked teacher profile as the canonical first-party professional profile for that person in the Bécsi Magyar Iskola ecosystem. Program facts remain canonical on the program selector/current official event page; professional biography facts remain canonical on the teacher directory.

## Geography
The ecosystem serves primarily Vienna (Wien), with additional programs in Baden bei Wien and online offerings where explicitly stated. The central BMI location is Schwedenplatz 2, 1010 Wien, entrance Laurenzerberg 5, first floor, doors 8–9.
